pricing.title: A plan for every size of calendar
pricing.lead: Every plan starts with 14 days of Pro for free. No card, no lock-in.

plans.name: Pro
plans.for: For businesses with a small team

items.q: Do I need a card for the 14-day trial?
items.a: No. You sign up with your email and use every Pro feature. When it ends you pick a plan or your account switches to read-only.
Turnio sends messages from a verified business account with buttons to confirm or reschedule. You can edit the text and choose when they go out.

items.q: Can I import my current calendar?
items.a: Yes. Import clients and bookings from Excel, CSV or Google Calendar. It takes a few minutes and deletes nothing from your original calendar.

items.q: What if a client cancels late?
items.a: You set the rule: keep the deposit, refund it or turn it into store credit. Turnio applies the rule automatically.

items.q: Do my clients need to download an app?
items.a: No. They book from a link that opens in any browser. You and your team use Turnio from your phone or computer.

items.q: Does it work for multiple locations?
items.a: Yes, on the Team plan. Each location has its own calendar, hours and staff, and you see consolidated reports.
Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, with daily backups. You can export or delete your information whenever you want.

items.q: Can I change plans or cancel?
items.a: Anytime, from the dashboard. Switching to annual applies the discount right away; if you cancel, the next period is not charged.
